facts.fact: Telecom operators' SIM registration, SIM swap and number portability ran on NIMC's identity verification platform, and were suspended in early July 2025 during migration to a new NIMC platform; NIMC said on 2 July that services including authentication were restored.

systems.platform: new NIMC-built platform; migration by BlueSalt Financial Services
